headers.comment: Firebase defaults every file to max-age=3600, so a deploy took up to an hour to reach anyone who had already visited. Pages and code have stable filenames (no content hash), so they must revalidate: no-cache still lets the browser keep the file and ask 'changed?', which the ETag answers with a cheap 304.
Images, fonts and audio are replaced rarely and are the heavy files — worth caching for a day.
